What I checked:
- CI on 9993607 is green (lint, typecheck, test, build). Vercel preview is ready.
- Test-first: `test(recorder): add rebuild equivalence test (#4)` (0a37aad) adds the key equivalence test and a `rebuild` stub that throws. Then `test(recorder): add rebuild helper and equivalence test (#4)` (9993607) implements the helper. The second commit only touches `test-utils/rebuild.ts`. No test was removed or loosened.
- The helper lives in `packages/recorder/test-utils/rebuild.ts`. A test checks that `rebuild` is not exported from the package entry.
- The key test records six callbacks (remove, move into a new section, nested add, `insertBefore` in the middle, attribute change, text change) and checks `rebuild(events).isEqualNode(document)` on a new document.
- `tsconfig.test.json` now includes `test-utils/`, so the helper is typechecked. It is not in the build.
- Commits are authored as the owner with the Cursor Agent co-author trailer.
